Goal: Increase sales from the 13-16 demographics by 15%



Target: Free-spirited non-conformists (aged 13 - 16): These young teenagers are adventurous and reject conforming to strict standards. Since outdoor activities are often associated with certain rules like dress code and particular gear, teens are turned off by traditional outdoor activities. They want to break these rules on their journey to develop their individual personalities and relationship with nature.



Challenge We Face: REI is perceived as a brand for intense and serious outdoor enthusiasts



Desired Action: Think REI is the place to shop for casual outdoor activities, and buy from REI



Insight: Teens embrace imperfections in their search for identity



Key Message: You don’t need perfect gear to have     perfect outdoor experience



Support Points: Gear rental, one-time purchase membership that lasts a lifetime, partnerships with outdoor programs like Hipcamp, outdoor classes, guided adventures
